title: PluginCashbacksPayload
description: Bank plugin response with cashback rules. Contains no ZenMoney connectionId/accountId. Bindings use account externalIds from the same plugin scrape, not ZenMoney account ids. Card-specific cashback is bound to the corresponding account. Raw bank text is allowed only in reward and scope for later client-side parsing.

scrapedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the plugin scraped this data.

cashbacks.description: Flat list of cashback rules, categories, and offers from the bank. content contains a structured title and an optional description; period and bindings must also be structured. The raw variant is allowed only for reward and scope.

externalId.description: Stable cashback/category/offer id from the bank, if available.

imageUrl.description: Bank-provided icon or image URL for this cashback.

Cashback.description: One cashback rule from a bank: a category, merchant offer, all-purchases cashback, or another earning condition. content contains a parsed non-empty title and an optional description. bindings is a required non-empty array of bindings. scope is required and must not be null. Only reward and scope may contain raw text.

CashbackContent.description: Structured cashback content with a required non-empty title and an optional description. The raw variant is not supported.

examples.title: Super cashback!
examples.description: 100% on everything, but only for members of parliament!

title.description: Parsed user-visible cashback title from the bank.

description.description: Parsed bank-provided explanation, restrictions, or conditions. Omit it when unavailable, or use null when explicitly known to be absent.

StructuredCashbackContent.description: Parsed cashback content with a required non-empty title and an optional description.

examples.title: Super cashback!
examples.description: 100% on everything, but only for members of parliament!

Reward.description: Polymorphic reward value. Use PercentReward for parsed percent rewards; use RawReward with only type and text when the bank exposes raw reward text such as "7% in bonus points".

value.description: Decimal value encoded as string to avoid floating-point precision issues.

unit.description: Reward unit. For percent rewards this must be PERCENT.

text.description: Raw bank-provided reward text, for example "7% in bonus points".

RawReward.description: Raw bank-provided reward text when the reward cannot be safely parsed or represented as a structured percent reward, for example "7% in bonus points". Uses text as the only payload field besides the type discriminator.

Period.description: Cashback validity period. DatedPeriod defines a parsed month, quarter, year, or custom interval with from/to dates; PermanentPeriod is used for cashback without known dates. The raw variant is not supported.

DatedPeriod.description: Dated cashback period such as month, quarter, year, or custom promo interval.

from.description: Permanent periods have no known start date. Use null when keeping a stable period object shape.

to.description: Permanent periods have no known end date. Use null when keeping a stable period object shape.

PermanentPeriod.description: Cashback without known dates, such as a permanent base rate. from/to may be omitted or set to null.

CashbackStatus.description: Cashback state: active applies automatically; selected was chosen by the user; available can be selected; future starts later. Use null when the bank did not provide the state or the plugin could not parse it. The expired status is not supported.

Bindings.description: Required non-empty array of Binding elements. Null and raw bindings are not allowed. { "type": "all" } means all plugin accounts and is normally the only element. An account binding externalId identifies an account from the same plugin scrape, not a ZenMoney account. Card-specific cashback is bound to the corresponding account.

Binding.description: Binding discriminated by type: all for every plugin account or account for one account identified by externalId. Card-specific cashback uses an account binding for the corresponding account. The raw variant is not supported.

AllBinding.description: All accounts returned by the plugin are eligible for this cashback. Normally use { "type": "all" } as the only element in a non-null bindings array.

externalId.description: Plugin account externalId returned by the same plugin scrape. This is not a ZenMoney account id.

AccountBinding.description: Exactly one plugin account is eligible for this cashback, identified by its externalId returned by the same plugin scrape. Use this binding for card-specific cashback by referencing the corresponding plugin account.

Scope.description: Required non-null purchase scope for matching transactions. Use parsed scopes when available: all purchases, MCC list, merchant, or bank category. Use RawScope with only type and text when the bank exposes raw scope text for later client-side parsing.

examples.text: Gas stations and car repair shops

AllPurchasesScope.description: Cashback applies to all purchases unless excluded.

exclude.description: Optional non-MCC exclusions from this scope. MCC exclusions are invalid because mcc already defines the final eligible MCC list.

MccScope.description: Cashback applies to transactions with listed MCC codes.

MerchantScope.description: Cashback applies to one bank-provided merchant/brand.

CategoryScope.description: Cashback applies to a bank category when MCCs/merchants are not exposed or are intentionally abstracted.

text.description: Raw bank-provided purchase scope text for later client-side parsing.

RawScope.description: Raw bank-provided purchase scope text when the plugin could scrape a scope but could not parse MCCs, merchants, or categories. This raw fallback uses text as the only payload field besides the type discriminator.

examples.text: Gas stations and car repair shops

ScopeExclusions.description: List of exclusions from a scope. Empty list means the bank explicitly returned no exclusions; omitted means the plugin did not receive or parse exclusions.

TextExclusion.description: Free-text exclusion that cannot be safely structured.

MccList.description: Non-empty list of 1-9999 Merchant Category Codes. Consumer constraint: client requires integer lexical encoding such as 5411; mathematically integral JSON numbers encoded as 5411.0 or 5411e0 cause invalid_request for the entire snapshot.

externalId.description: Merchant id from the bank, if available.
Category id from the bank, if available.
